lines: View Open Roles
From the initial application through interviews and evaluations, we focus on getting to know you as a whole person - your skills, aspirations and potential to contribute to our team.

Our hiring process is designed to identify exceptional talent. We assess candidates on their strengths, aptitude, experiences, and - critically - their alignment with our culture. This ensures we bring in individuals who not only excel professionally but also thrive in our environment.

Beyond evaluating skills and potential, we look for individuals who are energized by our culture - one rooted in a deep commitment to client service and a relentless pursuit of excellence. Our interviews consider both the professional demands and the values that define success here. This helps candidates envision their path and increases the likelihood of a strong, lasting fit.
Open Architecture

Our student and graduate programmes offer multiple pathways to build real skills, gain exposure and make an impact early on. We’re committed to attracting people from a broad range of backgrounds to help shape our future.

As a Graduate, you will attend our Global Graduate Training Programme to build core financial knowledge, communication skills and teamwork. Whether you’re new to finance or already have relevant experience, the programme is designed to develop your strengths and help you make an impact from week one. You’ll also build a strong global network, connecting with peers across our international offices.

As an Intern, you’ll join a team, gain hands-on experience, and be entrusted with meaningful responsibilities from the outset. You’ll be supported through on-the-job training and mentoring while working on real project work.
Explore our Internship opportunities

Gaining early exposure to financial services is a powerful way to explore your interests and shape your future career. Our Insight Week Programmes offer a real insight into life at Rothschild & Co, combining interactive workshops, practical training and networking opportunities to help you build skills, broaden your understanding, and make informed career decisions.

With open positions in more than 12 countries, our International Graduate Programme offers you a unique experience in a global investment bank. You will join a diverse and dynamic team, that will provide learning and development opportunities to launch your career, and grow both professionally and personally.
